classification: prospective protocol; no independent results yet
target: log(Close[t+h]/Close[t]); price index, no dividend total return

inference.method: paired moving block bootstrap and Bartlett HAC
inference.multiplicity: Holm across all 24 index/horizon/pair tests; bootstrap intervals marginal

intervals.quantile: ceil((n+1)*coverage); infinite if rank exceeds n

selection: validation RMSE only; smaller candidate wins exact tie; no refit after validation
gate: new source must record URL/version/retrieval UTC/license/adjustments/SHA256 and prior exposure declaration; human independence cannot be inferred from timestamps
stopping: one fixed 252-origin prospective test per index/horizon; no optional stopping or retuning on outcomes
